title: Chip equipment maker Lam Research plans to invest $3B+ over five years to expand its global R&D network, aiming to increase its experiment capacity by 50%+ (Anzar Mehraj/Reuters)
summary: Anzar Mehraj / Reuters: Chip equipment maker Lam Research plans to invest $3B+ over five years to expand its global R&D network, aiming to increase its experiment capacity by 50%+ — Lam Research (LRCX.O) said on Thursday it intends to invest more than $3 billion in the next five years to expand its global research …
